_about: The picture for each page of the journal's Mechanics tab, shown large in the tutorial window (Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_ui_art.py tutorials, 1280x720). Keyed by the page's title (AgentScripts/BuildJournal.cs). Each shows the thing being done, in a wide scene, with the person small or seen from behind so no face has to match anyone. 'home' is the Haven's warm style, 'raid' the dark forest's.

Your Windows.prompt: A cosy corner of a Norse log cabin by warm firelight: a leather satchel spilling tools and herbs, an open journal with sketches, a rolled map, a carved wooden chest and a small hand axe on a wooden table, all neatly laid out like a traveller's belongings.

Your Journal.prompt: An open leather-bound journal on a rough wooden table by candlelight, its pages full of hand-drawn sketches of forest creatures, plants and runes, a quill and ink pot beside it, a pressed fern between the pages.

Sneaking.prompt: A hooded figure seen from behind crouching low in tall ferns among mossy pine trunks at dusk, watching a large grey wolf that has not noticed them in a misty clearing ahead.

Woodcutting.prompt: A woodcutter seen from behind swinging an axe at a tall pine tree in a sunny forest clearing, wood chips flying from a deep notch in the trunk, felled logs and a stack of split wood nearby.

Mining.prompt: A person seen from the side striking a large grey boulder streaked with glowing orange copper ore with an iron pickaxe, chips of stone flying, a basket of ore chunks beside them, a rocky hillside with birch trees.

Foraging.prompt: Hands reaching into a lush forest floor picking red lingonberries, a woven basket already holding golden chanterelle mushrooms, herbs and berries, ferns and moss all around in soft morning light.

Fishing.prompt: A figure seen from behind standing on a small wooden pier fishing with a simple bent wooden rod and no reel in a calm misty mountain lake at dawn, the line taut, a ripple and splash where a fish fights, pine forest on the far shore.

Swings and Chains.prompt: A Norse warrior seen from behind in mid-swing with a sword, a bright arc trailing the blade, fighting a snarling cursed wolf in a dark misty forest.

Guard and Parry.prompt: A Norse warrior raising a round wooden shield just in time as a huge moss-covered troll's club strikes it, sparks and splinters flying, in a dark misty forest.

Dodging.prompt: A Norse warrior rolling sideways out of the way of a charging blight boar with dark bristles and glowing green eyes, dust and leaves kicked up, dark forest path.

Stamina and Focus.prompt: A tired Norse warrior catching their breath, leaning on a sword in a dark forest clearing, a faint golden glow of gathered power swirling around their free hand.

Poise and Stagger.prompt: A skeletal undead draug in rusted mail staggering backwards, off balance with its shield knocked aside, as a Norse warrior presses the attack in a misty barrow.

Backstabs and Finishing Blows.prompt: A Norse warrior striking a staggered undead draug from behind with a sword, a bright flash at the strike, ancient burial mounds and mist behind.

Getting Hit.prompt: A Norse warrior knocked back by the blow of a large moss troll, stumbling, shield arm thrown wide, in a dark rainy forest.

Archery.prompt: An archer seen from behind drawing a longbow to full draw, aiming across a misty forest glade at a distant cursed wolf, an arrow nocked, quiver on the back.

Abilities.prompt: A Norse warrior casting a spell, a spear of glowing blue ice and frost breaking from a carved rune in the air before them, lighting up a dark forest.

Setting Out.prompt: An ancient ring of cracked standing stones with a shimmering blue-green portal glowing between them in a forest clearing, a traveller with a pack and spear walking towards it at dawn.

The Clock and the Way Out.prompt: A figure running through a darkening misty forest towards a glowing doorway of light between two old standing stones, the sky turning red, shadows closing in behind.

What You Can Lose.prompt: A dropped leather pack spilling ore, herbs and tools onto the mossy forest floor at night, a broken spear beside it, mist rolling in, eerie glow between the trees.

Carrying It Home.prompt: A traveller seen from behind pulling a heavily loaded wooden handcart piled with logs, sacks and ore along a forest path towards a distant glowing village at sunset.

Companions.prompt: Two Norse adventurers seen from behind walking side by side into a misty forest, one with a bow, one with a shield and spear, back to back and watchful.

The Ward and Renown.prompt: A small Norse village of turf-roofed log cabins in a forest clearing at dusk, a faint dome of glowing golden light around it holding back the dark mist of the forest beyond.

Building.prompt: A half-built Norse log cabin with a timber scaffold in a sunny forest clearing, a hammer and planks, freshly cut logs stacked beside it, a finished cabin with a turf roof behind.

Stations and Work.prompt: A warm Norse village workshop at dusk: a glowing forge with an anvil, a weaving loom and a bubbling cauldron under turf-roofed shelters, villagers busy at work.

Nights and Breaches.prompt: A Norse village of log cabins at night, torches and a palisade of sharpened stakes, dark shapes of cursed wolves and trolls gathering at the edge of the firelight in the forest.

Hunger and Thirst.prompt: A hearty Norse meal on a wooden table: a bowl of steaming stew, dark bread, grilled fish, berries and a horn of water by a warm fire.

Skills and Perks.prompt: A Norse craftsman's workbench seen at golden hour with well-worn tools of many crafts laid out: an axe, a pickaxe, a fishing rod, a bow, a hammer, a ladle and a carving knife.

Essence.prompt: A stone altar carved with runes in a dark grove, a wisp of purple cursed essence flowing into a stone bowl and rising out of it as pure white-gold light.

The Haven's Reach.prompt: A tall carved standing stone at the edge of a misty pine forest, its runes glowing warm amber, and beside it a lone traveller standing upright, seen from behind and small in the frame, one hand resting flat on the stone; a winding path behind leads back across meadows to a distant clearing where a faint glow and hearth smoke rise, evening light.
